name: The Bloody Inn
summary: A card-driven innkeeping game where rival farmers lure travelers, recruit accomplices, murder guests and bury them to steal their money.
rules_text: France 1831. Players share an inn board with rooms. A shuffled deck of Guest cards (travelers with rank 0-3 and peasants) forms the Entrance stack. Each round: First player draws from Entrance and places one guest in each open, empty room. Then in turn order each player takes 2 actions: Bribe (pay cards equal to target's rank from hand to take a guest from any room or 1-2 peasants from bistro into hand; cards with bribe aptitude return to hand), Build Annex (pay rank to place a guest from hand face-up as a permanent power), Kill (pay rank to take a guest from inn/bistro and place dead in front of you), Bury (pay costs and need annex spaces to discard dead guests to gain their franc value plus checks), or Pass to launder checks into francs on wealth track. Peasants discarded always go to bistro. Used guest cards without aptitude go to Exit stack. When Entrance empties first time, shuffle Exit into new Entrance. Second time it empties, play one final round. Richest player on wealth track wins.
rating_reason: Inn card game with hidden hands, bribery, bluffing fits engine.
